report.title: Report content
report.intro: Report a listing or content you believe is illegal (EU Digital Services Act Art. 16). A person reviews every notice; the decision and its reasons are emailed to you.
report.explanation: Explain why it is illegal (at least 20 characters)
report.goodFaith: I believe in good faith that the information and allegations in this notice are accurate and complete.
report.sent: We received your notice. Your reference: {reference}. A confirmation email will be sent within a few minutes; if it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder.
report.invalid: Please fill in all required fields correctly.
report.rateLimited: Too many notices sent; please try again later.
report.error: The notice could not be sent; please try again.

errors.contentUrl: Enter a valid address, for example https://example.com/listing/123.
errors.explanation: The explanation must be at least 20 characters, not counting spaces.
errors.reporterName: The name can be at most 120 characters.
errors.reporterEmail: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.
errors.goodFaith: Confirm the good-faith statement to send the notice.
errors.propertyNotFound: This listing can no longer be found. Check the content address and send again.

report.contentUrlHint: Full address, e.g. https://example.com/property/123. The “Report this listing” link on a listing page fills this in for you.
report.errorSummary: Please fix {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} in the form:
report.sentEmail: A confirmation email will be sent to {email} within a few minutes; if it doesn't arrive, check your spam folder.
report.referenceHint: Share this number if you contact support.
report.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the number and copy it manually.

next.review: A member of our team reviews your notice.
next.decision: The decision and its reasons are emailed to you.
next.appeal: If you disagree, you can appeal using the link in the decision email (DSA Art. 20).

report.reporterEmailHint: Confirmation and decision emails are sent to this address. It is used only to contact you about this notice.
report.privacyNote: Your name and email address are not shared with the property owner; only our team reviewing the notice sees them. For details, read the <link>privacy notice</link>.
report.timeout: The connection timed out. What you entered is kept; you can send the notice again.
report.rateLimitedRetry: Too many notices sent. Please try again in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
report.rateLimitedAlt: If it can't wait, <link>contact our support team</link>.

admin.title: Compliance
admin.intro: 7565 takedown requests (24-hour SLA), DSA notices, Art. 20 appeals, the accessibility verification queue and the transparency report.
admin.createTakedown: Record request and take listing down
admin.takedownCreated: Request recorded; the listing “{listing}” was taken down.
admin.noticeDecided: Decision recorded for “{url}”; the statement of reasons will be sent.
admin.exportJson: View JSON (opens in a new tab)
admin.propertyIdHint: Paste the listing ID; when you leave the field, the listing name is shown below.

preview.missing: No published listing was found with this ID. Check the ID.

confirmTakedown.title: Take the listing down now?
confirmTakedown.body: The listing {listing} is unpublished as soon as this request is saved. It cannot be republished until the request is closed.
confirmTakedown.confirm: Save request and take down listing

closeForm.warning: A closed request cannot be reopened; the host may republish the listing.

confirmDecision.title: Save this decision?
confirmDecision.removedEffect: The listing is taken down; the reporter and the host receive a statement of reasons by email.
confirmDecision.noActionEffect: The content stays online; the reporter and the host receive a statement of reasons by email.
confirmDecision.final: A saved decision cannot be changed; it is only reviewed again if one of the parties appeals.

admin.receivedAt: Date and time the order was received (Turkey time)
admin.receivedAtHint: Enter it in Turkey time (UTC+3); the 24-hour deadline starts from this moment. Default: now.
admin.factsHint: At least 10 characters. This text is sent to the parties in the statement of reasons.

report.invalidRange: The end date cannot be before the start date.

errors.validation: Some fields are missing or invalid. Fix the marked fields and try again.
errors.propertyNotFound: No listing was found with this ID. Check the listing ID.
errors.takedownDuplicate: An open request already exists for this listing and document number.
errors.takedownNotFound: Request “{item}” no longer exists; the list was refreshed.
errors.takedownClosed: Request “{item}” was already closed; the list was refreshed.
errors.noticeNotFound: The notice for “{url}” no longer exists; the list was refreshed.
errors.noticeDecided: A decision was already recorded for “{url}”; the list was refreshed.

fields.propertyId: Enter the listing ID (up to 64 characters).
fields.referenceNo: The document number can be up to 120 characters.
fields.reason: The reason must be 3 to 2,000 characters.
fields.receivedAt: Enter a valid date and time.
fields.ground: Choose a ground for the removal decision.
fields.facts: Facts and reasoning must be 10 to 5,000 characters.
fields.legalReference: The legal reference can be up to 300 characters.
fields.resolution: The reason for closing must be 3 to 2,000 characters.

noticeQueue.title: Pending DSA notices ({count})
noticeQueue.order: Notices waiting longest are listed first.
noticeQueue.removeUnavailable: This notice isn't linked to a listing, so it can't be removed; you can only choose to take no action.

fieldLimits.near: You're close to the character limit.
fieldLimits.reached: You've reached the character limit; extra text won't be added.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.verifiedHint: Our team verified this feature against photo evidence provided by the host.
accessibility.disclosure: Only features verified with evidence are shown. If you have a specific need, contact Support before booking and mention the listing name.
accessibility.filterHint: All selected features must be verified in the same room.

host.title: Accessibility features
host.intro: Declare your listing's accessibility features and link evidence from your listing photos to each one. Only features our team has verified against the evidence appear on the listing and in search.
host.widthRange: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max} cm.
host.evidenceSaved: Evidence updated for {name}; the feature will be reviewed again.
host.evidenceVerifiedWarning: This feature is verified. If you change and save the evidence, verification is removed and the platform team reviews it again.
host.deleteConfirmBody: The feature is permanently removed from the list.
host.deleteConfirmVerified: The verified badge is removed and the feature no longer shows on the listing or in search. If you add it again, the platform team must review it again.
host.alreadyAdded: This feature is already added for the selected scope. Choose another feature or scope.
host.noPhotosHint: Evidence is chosen from this listing's photos; no photos have been uploaded yet.
host.editWidthHint: Enter a whole number between {min} and {max} cm. Changing the width removes verification and our team reviews it again.
host.editNoteHint: Changing the note doesn't affect verification.
host.widthVerifiedWarning: This feature is verified. If you change the width, verification is removed and our team reviews it again.
host.verifiedStatusHint: Shown on the listing and in search.
host.pendingReviewHint: Appears on the listing and in search once our team reviews and verifies the evidence.
host.needsEvidenceHint: Choose and save evidence from your listing photos; it appears on the listing once our team verifies it.
host.noteHint: Up to {max} characters; {remaining, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}} left.

admin.title: Accessibility verification queue
admin.intro: Host declarations with evidence photos. Verify only when the photo clearly shows the feature.

confirm.verifyEffect: The feature is shown as verified on the listing and in search.
confirm.unverifyEffect: The feature is hidden on the listing and in search and returns to the awaiting-review list.

errors.evidenceRequired: A feature without an evidence photo can't be verified. Wait for the host to add evidence.
errors.notFound: This declaration no longer exists; the host may have deleted it.

accessibility.noneVerified: There is no verified accessibility information for this listing yet; this does not mean the features are missing. If you have a specific need, contact Support before booking and mention the listing name.
accessibility.evidenceLabel: Evidence photo for {feature} (opens in a new tab)
accessibility.verifiedExplainer: The “Verified” badge means our team checked the feature against photo evidence provided by the host.
accessibility.filterSummary: {count, plural, =0 {Choose features} one {# feature selected} other {# features selected}}

appeal.title: Appeal a decision
appeal.intro: Under Article 20 of the EU Digital Services Act (DSA), you can appeal a content moderation decision. A qualified member of staff reviews your appeal and emails you the outcome.
appeal.invalidLink: This appeal link is incomplete or incorrect. Use the full link from your decision email; if the problem continues, contact our support team with the decision ID and your email address.

existing.PENDING: Your appeal was received and is under review (reference: {reference}).
existing.UPHELD: Your appeal was upheld; the decision was reversed (reference: {reference}).
existing.REJECTED: Your appeal was rejected (reference: {reference}). Under DSA Art. 21, you may refer the matter to a certified out-of-court dispute settlement body.

appeal.windowClosed: The appeal period for this decision has ended.
appeal.reasonHint: Explain why the decision is wrong (at least 20 characters).
appeal.sent: We received your appeal (reference: {reference}). You will be emailed the outcome.
appeal.rateLimited: Too many attempts; please try again later.
appeal.alreadySubmitted: You have already appealed this decision.
appeal.error: The appeal could not be sent. Please try again.

admin.title: DSA appeals (Art. 20)
admin.intro: Upholding an appeal reverses the earlier decision: after a removal the host may relist; after a no-action decision the listing is removed.
admin.groundHint: A ground is required because the listing will be removed.
admin.decided: Appeal decision saved for “{item}”; the outcome will be emailed.

confirm.title: Save the appeal decision?
confirm.upheldRemove: The earlier decision is reversed and the listing is taken down.
confirm.upheldRestore: The earlier takedown is reversed; the listing may be republished.
confirm.rejected: The earlier decision stays in place.
confirm.final: A saved appeal decision cannot be changed and is emailed to the appellant.

errors.decided: The appeal for “{item}” was already decided; the list was refreshed.
errors.notFound: The appeal for “{item}” no longer exists; the list was refreshed.

appeal.notDecided: No appealable decision was found for this link. The notice may not have been decided yet; you will be emailed when a decision is made.
appeal.loadFailed: The decision details could not be loaded right now. Please refresh the page in a moment.
appeal.daysLeft: {days, plural, =0 {Ends today} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
appeal.disputeHelp: Ask our support team about out-of-court dispute settlement (DSA Art. 21)
appeal.timeout: The connection timed out. What you entered is kept; you can send the appeal again.
appeal.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the reference and copy it manually.
appeal.nextSteps: A qualified member of staff reviews your appeal. If it is upheld, the earlier decision is reversed; if it is rejected, you may refer the matter to an out-of-court dispute settlement body (DSA Art. 21).
